capabilities.name: Core document loading and media types
capabilities.covered: Both historical standalone Codecept PDF-loading journeys are retired: Playwright smoke proves local fixture loading, rendered page readiness, canvas dimensions and navigation, and supports the migrated local-AAT launch path. Functional tests exceed them with image loading, PDF replacement/rendered page identity and unsupported-media diagnostics
capabilities.gap: Live AAT/DM Store retrieval and Office conversion are reported separately; audio/video playback is tracked under Multimedia playback

capabilities.name: AAT document prerequisites
capabilities.covered: Active Codecept scenarios upload PDF, image and Word fixtures into a CCD case through DM Store
capabilities.gap: These scenarios prepare documents but do not assert Media Viewer rendering; add Playwright integration coverage for DM Store-backed retrieval

capabilities.name: CCD case creation prerequisite
capabilities.covered: The active createCCDCase.js Codecept scenario creates and submits the CCD case used by Media Viewer journeys
capabilities.gap: This is test-data setup rather than Media Viewer rendering assurance; replace it with deterministic Playwright setup before retiring the legacy prerequisite

capabilities.name: Office document conversion
capabilities.covered: Playwright submits a Word conversion request, proves the returned PDF renders with a success result, and proves an unavailable conversion renders a visible failure without a PDF viewer
capabilities.gap: The deterministic document-assembly route fake proves browser behaviour; live document-assembly/AAT integration remains a separate assurance boundary

capabilities.name: Page navigation
capabilities.covered: All historical Codecept scenarios are retired. Playwright covers next/previous, page input, rendered page identity, viewport state and document boundaries
capabilities.gap: Bundle and nested-document index navigation remains legacy-only

capabilities.name: Zoom
capabilities.covered: All historical Codecept scenarios are retired. Playwright covers PDF/image round-trip and minimum/maximum scale boundaries
capabilities.gap: No remaining high-value gap identified in this standalone slice

capabilities.name: Rotation
capabilities.covered: All historical Codecept scenarios are retired. Playwright covers PDF orientation and image transform round-trips using intrinsic rendered state, reset after PDF document replacement, default-state reset after reload for both media types, and restoration of server-supplied PDF orientation metadata
capabilities.gap: The standalone demo exposes no Save rotation action; persistence writes require a separate integration surface rather than a fabricated UI journey

capabilities.name: Search
capabilities.covered: All historical Codecept scenarios are retired. Playwright covers positive search, next/previous, no results, close/reset, recovery, Enter navigation and rendered highlight-all, exact-case and whole-word option contracts
capabilities.gap: No remaining high-value gap identified in this standalone slice

capabilities.name: Comments panel
capabilities.covered: All historical Codecept scenarios are retired. Playwright covers direct-toolbar panel lifecycle; create, update, removal and cancel semantics; immediate and rehydrated rendered state; stale-highlight reset, no-result and multi-result search; cross-page search navigation; rendered summary/page-link navigation; document-isolated persistence; and selected-text/two-comment summary coverage supplied by PDF annotations
capabilities.gap: No remaining high-value gap identified in this standalone slice

capabilities.name: PDF annotations and comments
capabilities.covered: Six historical Codecept UI scenarios are retired. Playwright covers real PDF text selection and draw-box creation, request and rendered geometry after reload, comment persistence through rotation and rehydration, two-comment collation, and every search result highlighted into a persisted annotation set
capabilities.gap: The legacy delete-all-highlights scenario remains active: a two-annotation Playwright contract exposed that the viewer does not emit the expected DELETE request. The functional suite also uses deterministic annotation API fakes, so add an AAT service contract after the delete flow is corrected

capabilities.name: Image annotations and comments
capabilities.covered: Playwright covers all four historical image annotation/comment behaviours: image draw-box creation with positive persisted geometry, comment creation and rehydration, comment update, and annotation deletion with rendered state removal
capabilities.gap: The legacy Codecept scenarios remain active until the deterministic functional contracts are complemented by an AAT service contract and the legacy retirement decision is approved

capabilities.name: Bookmarks
capabilities.covered: All eight historical Codecept bookmark scenarios are retired. Playwright covers real text-selection contextual bookmark creation, panel creation, update, delete with sibling promotion, single and multiple empty drafts, document-position/custom sorting and 30-bookmark lifecycle with deterministic bookmark API fixtures; the rendered reorder regression remains discoverable as an intentionally skipped test
capabilities.gap: Rendered bookmark order after drag persistence is blocked by EXUI-5097; re-enable the skipped reorder test after the product fix is delivered and verified in AAT/preview

capabilities.name: Index and outline
capabilities.covered: Codecept coverage exists for bundle and nested-document navigation
capabilities.gap: No Playwright functional coverage for index, outline or attachment selection

capabilities.name: Print and download
capabilities.covered: Both historical PDF action-only Codecept scenarios are retired. Playwright reaches the visible toolbar or overflow menu, proves the loaded PDF URL is handed to the print API, and proves PDF.js hands the same URL plus configured filename to the browser download contract
capabilities.gap: Native browser print dialogs and download-manager UI are browser-owned; the functional contract asserts the exact hand-off inputs rather than treating a platform dialog as product state

capabilities.name: Redaction
capabilities.covered: Playwright covers a real draw-box gesture, persisted positive geometry, preview state, clear-all deletion, redaction request payload and downloaded PDF filename using deterministic markup and redaction-service responses
capabilities.gap: Text selection, search/redact-all, single-marker removal, page and multi-page journeys remain active Codecept coverage. Add AAT/service-contract evidence before retiring the legacy safety net

capabilities.name: Multimedia playback
capabilities.covered: Both historical Codecept scenarios are retired. Playwright exceeds their action/screenshot coverage with MP4 readiness, real MP3 play/pause/rewind state transitions through keyboard interaction, disabled-player download behaviour and unsupported-media diagnostics
capabilities.gap: No remaining high-value gap identified in the standalone multimedia-player slice

capabilities.name: In-court presentation (ICP)
capabilities.covered: Playwright opens presentation mode for leader and follower browser pages, starts presenting, and proves a server screen update moves the follower viewport and synchronises zoom and rotation
capabilities.gap: The browser journey uses a deterministic ICP session/socket fake; live session-service and Web PubSub multi-user integration remain unproven
